dependencies: npm ci using package-lock.json; SQLite native addon may require platform build tools if no prebuilt binary exists

credentials.canonicalFile: operator repo-root secrets.env (ignored/symlink); pass its absolute path with --secrets
credentials.gemini: GEMINI_API_KEY (selected local Codex audio/video perception; separately billed)

hostAgent.author: actual bound host worker or trusted runTask(task,{worker,callTool}) host integration
hostAgent.reviewer: independent worker with actual text/image/audio perception, STT and speaker-similarity tools
hostAgent.backgroundOwner: plain-language scene direction and outcome check; distinct from technical prompter
hostAgent.backgroundPrompter: separate worker using background-prompter.md; cannot self-review or human-approve
hostAgent.shotPlanner: scene-led shot plan with approved location/cast images; four exact 15-second beat timelines
hostAgent.compositionWriter: single-frame reference-bound scene prompt; independent reviewer needs actual image perception
hostAgent.videoEngineer: observable frame-bound motion; separate independent qualified full-video reviewer
hostAgent.soundDesigner: instrumental piano and relevant effects with rights/provenance
hostAgent.filmEditor: approved trim/mix plan, natural-rate narration; one official local assembler
hostAgent.visualQualification: actual human-labelled held-out image/video anatomy, identity and continuity examples, actual independent worker predictions
hostAgent.compute: current chat host for creative/reviewer workers; selected Gemini 3.8 Flash API for local Codex listening/video observations
hostAgent.audioQualification: separate genuinely human-labelled held-out audio, full listening, STT and speaker comparison; model/tool profile bound to Ava
hostAgent.permissions: runtime-enforced format broker and submission allowlists; ambient host shell/filesystem/tools require host enforcement
hostAgent.finalFilm: qualified distinct Vera visual and Ava audio reviews, then human approval

localCodex.runtime: Installed signed-in Codex CLI; documented experimental app-server dynamic tools (verified with 0.153.0)
localCodex.cost: Worker turns consume the signed-in account limits; no separate model API key required for ChatGPT login
localCodex.implemented: Durable role threads and partial startup receipts, scoped native image delivery, explicit model/profile/requalification, durable dispatch results, bounded dispatch
localCodex.missing: independent STT, calibrated speaker similarity and real reviewer qualification

mediaReview.calls: explicit --review-calls 0–32 per invocation, default 0; no automatic fallback/retry
mediaReview.profile: static min(source FPS,4) video (operator-selected), high resolution; original audio/separate mono 48kHz PCM from video
mediaReview.qualification: not production-qualified; profile changes require explicit crew refresh and held-out qualification

storage: per-run embedded SQLite checkpoints and immutable local assets/receipts; retain directory as a unit
approval: real human deliverable approvals; exact paid-request authorization or explicit bounded operation allowance
pending: actual perceptual-worker qualification and labeled corpus

renderer.browser: Chrome Headless Shell (Remotion setup) or MEMOIR_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE
renderer.audio: FFmpeg natural-rate mixing; ffprobe/FFmpeg technical inspection
renderer.preview: localhost Remotion Player; exact shared scene and audio; no approvals changed

providerReadiness.scope: authenticated GET metadata only; never generation, billing proof, approval or state mutation
providerReadiness.remaining: inference permissions, funds and account-specific cost estimates require further verification

chatDelivery.scope: exact version-bound reviewed deliverable and four separate narration players; failed/stale/tampered work blocked
chatDelivery.humanDecision: actual user event through respond; no fabricated approval
